description.value: Japanese Bistro Kamome is a small Japanese bistro and lounge bar in Vancouver's Joyce-Collingwood neighbourhood serving classic and modern Japanese cuisine. The restaurant's signature creation is the 'Ja-Panini,' a grilled rice sandwich with a choice of meat, seafood, or vegetables wrapped in seaweed and pressed on a panini press. The lounge side of the menu features cocktails including a range of martinis and mojitos.
